Definition: Nachaliel, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Nahaliel is a place in the desert on Israel's march, named once in the list of stopping places. In Numbers 21:19 the people go from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth, on the road through the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a stopping place in the wilderness is still part of the journey God led. Nahaliel is one camp among many, and the march went on.
